issues.title: Lesson videos not playing for students
issues.problem_statement: Some of the customer's students say the lesson videos keep loading and never play, mostly on their phones.

items.description: Support opened the lesson link the customer shared on Chrome, Safari and a phone; the video played fine each time and support could not reproduce the problem from their side, while the customer maintained that students are facing it.
evidence: It plays on Safari and on my phone too. So I cannot reproduce the problem from my side.

items.description: Support will raise the problem with the technical team and get back to the customer; support said they could not give a timeline at this point.
evidence: I'll raise this with our technical team and get back to you.
I can't give you a timeline right now

items.description: Customer will ask one affected student to record a short screen recording showing the video loading and send it to support, along with the lesson link.
evidence: Okay, I'll ask one of the students to record it and send it to you.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
